name: eyaushev-swagger-testcase-mcp
description: MCP server for API test case generation from Swagger/OpenAPI specs. Parses Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.x, generates test cases across 8 categories (happy path, validation, auth, error handling, boundary, security injection, idempotency, pagination/concurrency) with export to Markdown, Gherkin, Postman, k6, pytest, Allure, and TestRail.
